// Holds comment markers as content.
fn markers() {
    let a = "// not a comment";
    let b = r#"/* not a comment */"#;
    let c = b"// not a comment either";
    let d = '/';
    let e = "a \" // not a comment after an escaped quote";
    let f: &'static str = r"// not a comment in a raw string";
    let g = format!("{}", "/* not a comment */");
    /* outer /* nested */ still the same comment */
    let _ = (a, b, c, d, e, f, g);
}

macro_rules! noted {
    // A comment inside a macro rule.
    () => { "// not a comment in a macro" };
}
